inherited_constraints.name: assignments_check1
inherited_constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE kind
    WHEN 'department_member'::text THEN ((department_id IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(subject_id, grade, academic_class_id, duty_id) = 0))
    WHEN 'department_head'::text THEN ((department_id IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(subject_id, grade, academic_class_id, duty_id) = 0))
    WHEN 'subject_teacher'::text THEN ((subject_id IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(department_id, academic_class_id, duty_id) = 0))
    WHEN 'grade_teacher'::text THEN ((grade IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(department_id, subject_id, academic_class_id, duty_id) = 0))
    WHEN 'grade_head'::text THEN ((grade IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(department_id, subject_id, academic_class_id, duty_id) = 0))
    WHEN 'homeroom'::text THEN ((academic_class_id IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(department_id, subject_id, duty_id) = 0))
    WHEN 'assistant_homeroom'::text THEN ((academic_class_id IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(department_id, subject_id, duty_id) = 0))
    WHEN 'duty_owner'::text THEN ((duty_id IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(subject_id, grade, academic_class_id) = 0))
    WHEN 'duty_assistant'::text THEN ((duty_id IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(subject_id, grade, academic_class_id) = 0))
    ELSE NULL::boolean
END)

scope+원본+owner 중복 방지 유지; 필요 시 기존 owner 카드를 재사용하되 해당 본인만 메모를 읽는다.
